mapper.sql: SELECT r.rcpt_id AS receipt_id, r.rcpt_dt, r.rcpt_amt, r.rmrk_desc FROM bill.rcpt r WHERE r.bill_id=#{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE bill.rcpt SET rcpt_dt=#{input.rcpt_dt},rcpt_amt=#{input.rcpt_amt},rmrk_desc=#{input.rmrk_desc} WHERE bill_id=#{id} AND rcpt_id=#{receiptId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM bill.rcpt WHERE bill_id=#{id} AND rcpt_id=#{receiptId}
mapper.sql: SELECT z.bill_id,z.bill_stg_id,false AS virtual_plan,z.bill_no,z.prj_id,z.project_name, z.customer_id,z.customer_name,z.contract_type,z.atrb_ym,z.bill_dt,z.sply_amt,z.vat_amt,z.tot_amt, z.bill_stts_cd,z.txinv_no,z.txinv_dt,z.rcpt_plan_dt,z.received_amt,z.adjusted_total_amt, CASE WHEN z.bill_stts_cd='CONFIRM' AND z.amnd_yn='N' THEN GREATEST(0,z.adjusted_total_amt-z.received_amt) ELSE 0 END AS receivable_amt, CASE WHEN z.rcpt_plan_dt IS NULL OR z.bill_stts_cd!='CONFIRM' OR z.amnd_yn!='N' OR z.adjusted_total_amt <= z.received_amt THEN NULL WHEN (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date-z.rcpt_plan_dt >= 60 THEN 3 WHEN (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date-z.rcpt_plan_dt >= 30 THEN 2 WHEN (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date-z.rcpt_plan_dt >= 7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS reminder_stage FROM ( SELECT b.*,p.prj_nm AS project_name,p.cust_ptnr_id AS customer_id,c.ptnr_nm AS customer_name, p.cntrct_ty_cd AS contract_type, CAST(COALESCE((SELECT SUM(r.rcpt_amt) FROM bill.rcpt r WHERE r.bill_id=b.bill_id),0) AS BIGINT) AS received_amt, b.tot_amt+CAST(COALESCE((SELECT SUM(a.tot_amt) FROM bill.bill a WHERE a.orgnl_bill_id=b.bill_id AND a.amnd_yn='Y' AND a.bill_stts_cd='CONFIRM'),0) AS BIGINT) AS adjusted_total_amt FROM bill.bill b JOIN prj.prj p ON p.prj_id=b.prj_id LEFT JOIN mst.ptnr c ON c.ptnr_id=p.cust_ptnr_id ) z
mapper.select: WHERE z.orgnl_bill_id=#{id} AND z.amnd_yn='Y' ORDER BY z.bill_id
SELECT b.orgnl_bill_id FROM bill.bill b WHERE b.bill_id=#{id}

SELECT d.asgn_id,a.dev_id,COALESCE(d.cntrct_dev_id,a.dev_id) AS cntrct_dev_id, n.dev_nm AS display_name,d.work_ym,d.mm_qty,m.mm_qty AS source_mm_qty,d.untprc_amt, d.work_day_qty,d.work_tm_qty,d.ovtm_tm_qty,d.ovtm_amt,d.bill_amt,d.rmrk_desc FROM bill.bill_dtl d LEFT JOIN asgn.asgn a ON a.asgn_id=d.asgn_id LEFT JOIN mst.dev n ON n.dev_id=COALESCE(d.cntrct_dev_id,a.dev_id) LEFT JOIN asgn.asgn_mth m ON m.asgn_id=d.asgn_id AND m.work_ym=d.work_ym WHERE d.bill_id=#{id} ORDER BY d.bill_dtl_id

SELECT concat(h.data_chg_ty_cd,' ',h.clmn_nm,' ',h.bfr_val,' → ',h.aft_val) AS description, h.chg_at AS changed_at,CAST(h.chg_user_id AS VARCHAR) AS user_id FROM sys.data_chg_hist h WHERE (h.tbl_nm='bill.bill' AND h.obj_rec_id=CAST(#{id} AS VARCHAR)) OR (h.tbl_nm='bill.rcpt' AND (h.rsn_desc=concat('청구 입금 #',CAST(#{id} AS VARCHAR)) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bill.rcpt r WHERE r.bill_id=#{id} AND CAST(r.rcpt_id AS VARCHAR)=h.obj_rec_id))) ORDER BY h.chg_at DESC,h.data_chg_hist_id DESC
